-----Internal escalation thread (Camila -> deal desk / finance)-----

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:20:15 -0800
Subject: Escalation: Quantaflow asking 35% — request exec approval >20%

Team — quick escalation. Quantaflow (growing platform customer) wants 35% off hosted API list across the committed tier. Key facts:
- ARR at list: ~$720k; with 25% I projected $540k. 35% would bring ARR to ~$468k (delta ~$72k).
- They will sign 12-month SOW, provide a reference case after launch, and have integration partners that could lead to expansion.
- Forecast attached (usage_forecast_QF.xlsx) and SOW draft.

Why I think we should approve beyond 20%:
- Strategic logo in healthcare analytics vertical, high expansion potential in 12–18 months.
- Short-term unit economics hit (~3–4% margin reduction on this deal at 35%), but predictable committed revenue and low support footprint.
- Procurement signoff contingent on 35% concession — otherwise deal at risk of slipping or shrinking.

Requesting: exec OK for up to 35% one-time concession for Hosted API pricing for this deal. If you prefer a cap, propose up to 30% as fallback. Need final by COB 12 Nov to keep momentum.

Attachments: Quantaflow_SOW_v3.pdf, usage_forecast_QF.xlsx

Camila

-----Reply: Marissa Cole (Head of Sales)-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:05:42 -0800
Subject: Re: Escalation: Quantaflow asking 35% — request exec approval >20%

Thanks for the write-up Camila. I agree this is a strategic logo and the external reference ask increases its value. Two follow-ups before I greenlight anything above 20%:
1) Rishi — can you quantify the margin impact (post-quantization/expected avg token cost) for 30% vs 35%? Need a one-line summary.
2) Vivek — do we have any carryover program (marketing/reference) we can guarantee in exchange for a lower discount? If we can secure a speaking slot or case study, that reduces our $ hit.

If both are okay, I'm comfortable approving up to 30% today. 35% would need a CRO/CFO sign-off (Marissa will loop if needed).

Marissa
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (408) 555-0199

-----Reply: Rishi Malhotra (Finance)-----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:43:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Escalation: Quantaflow asking 35% — request exec approval >20%

Quick numbers: based on our quantization and expected token mix, the incremental margin delta vs list is approximately:
- 25% discount: ~+22% gross margin on this customer (baseline).
- 30% discount: ~+18% gross margin.
- 35% discount: ~+14% gross margin.

Economic take: moving from 25% to 35% reduces margin by ~8 percentage points but given the committed volume and low ongoing support, a 30% concession looks sustainable. 35% starts to erode our preferred threshold for deals without additional contractual protections (e.g., minimum monthly commitment, payment in advance).

Rishi
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

-----Reply: Vivek Kulkarni (Sales Ops/Revenue Growth)-----
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 13:12:51 -0800
Subject: Re: Escalation: Quantaflow asking 35% — request exec approval >20%

I can secure a marketing/reference package: 1) 1x launch webinar slot, 2) co-branded case study to be published within 6 months, and 3) intro to two integration partners. That materially offsets the revenue impact if Quantaflow delivers the reference.

Given Rishi's numbers and the additional marketing bucket, I'm comfortable with up to 30% net concession today. For 35% I'm ok only if we add strict clawback language (12-month minimum MRR guarantee or payment upfront for first 3 months).

Vivek
Revenue Growth
